  category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_count,
  ROUND(SUM(unit_price_eur * quantity), 2) AS total_item_revenue
FROM luxexperience.order_items
GROUP BY category

results.question: For each platform, what is the average order value in EUR and the average number of items per order?

raw.sql:
WITH order_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.platform,
        o.gmv_eur,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count
    FROM luxexperience.orders o
    JOIN luxexperience.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.platform, o.gmv_eur
)
SELECT 
    platform,
    ROUND(AVG(gmv_eur), 2) AS avg_order_value,
    ROUND(AVG(item_count), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM order_metrics
GROUP BY platform

guarded.sql:
WITH order_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.platform,
        o.gmv_eur,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count
    FROM luxexperience.orders o
    JOIN luxexperience.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.platform, o.gmv_eur
)
SELECT 
    platform,
    ROUND(AVG(gmv_eur), 2) AS avg_order_value,
    ROUND(AVG(item_count), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM order_metrics
GROUP BY platform

ontology.sql:
SELECT
  o.platform,
  ROUND(SUM(o.gmv_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value_eur,
  ROUND(COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM luxexperience.orders AS o
LEFT JOIN luxexperience.order_items AS oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY
  o.platform

ontology_guarded.sql:

  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

  o.platform
